# Vietnam

Values for an OG-Core calibration, then the estimates behind them. How to use them: [calibration guide](../calibration-guide.md).

## Values for OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Wealth gradient | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | −0.48, by age as below | MICS 2011, TFR, plus [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md) |
| `infmort_gradient` | −1.34 | DHS 2002, infant mortality rate |
| `mort_gradient` | −1.20 (95% prediction interval −1.93 to −0.47) | [general gradient](../methods/general-gradient.md) at GDP per capita (PPP, constant 2021 international $) of $15,457 (2025, World Bank) |
| `imm_pctiles` | not provided | — |

Divide each value by 100 × (1 − p) before passing it to OG-Core ([how](../calibration-guide.md#converting-a-gradient-to-og-cores-units)).

**`fert_gradient` by age of mother** ([how](../calibration-guide.md#fertility-by-age)):

| 15–19 | 20–24 | 25–29 | 30–34 | 35–39 | 40–44 | 45–49 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| −1.26 | −0.58 | −0.27 | −0.16 | −0.39 | −0.87 | −1.46 |

**`mort_gradient` by age** ([how](../calibration-guide.md#mortality-by-age)):

| 1–4 | 5–14 | 15–29 | 30–44 | 45–59 | 60–74 | 75+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| −2.17 (DHS 2002) | −1.60 | −1.60 | −1.38 | −0.99 | −0.99 at 60, falling to 0 at 75 | 0 |

*Note:* The most recent survey with infant mortality by wealth quintile is from 2002. Gradients can change substantially over such a period; state the survey year when using this value.
